audit.why: Early edge Viktor (Asol has no early pressure), even mid as he stacks, Viktor favoured through items per 51.09% WR over 1562 games. Existing text matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'Death Ray' for Viktor E (really Hextech Ray, per own kit text); breakdown.cooldowns has no numbers; the channel interaction (Viktor W Gravity Field stun cancels Asol Q Breath of Light channel) was never stated; Asol E Singularity's execute/percent-health pull never mentioned.
audit.why: Kit files: Viktor E text says 'fire a Hextech Ray'; Asol Q flagged channel/interruptible; Viktor W hardCC stun; Asol W CD 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: See edits: name fixed, cooldown numbers added, channel-cancel stated.

audit.why: Kit gives W CD 22s rank 1 scaling to 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interactions from _missing file: Gravity Field cancels Breath of Light/Astral Flight channel; Asol R stun can interrupt owner patterns; Singularity bypasses resist stacking.
audit.corrected: Channel-cancel and Astral Flight numbers folded into cooldowns/whys; Singularity noted in notes (no room without breaking length band elsewhere).

edits.before: Aurelion Sol is a pure scaling stacker with no early kill pressure, so shove with E (Death Ray) and deny his Q (Breath of Light) stacks by keeping him off the wave.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol is a pure scaling stacker with no early kill pressure, so shove with E (Hextech Ray) and deny his Q (Breath of Light) stacks by keeping him off the wave.

edits.before: You have the edge early because Aurelion Sol is a slow-scaling stacker with no burst or mobility, while your E (Death Ray) lets you shove and poke him off the wave. His whole game plan is farming Q (Breath of Light) stacks safely, so every minion and every bit of poke you deny sets his scaling back. Push the first waves in and force him to farm under tower or eat damage. Deny him the free early game he wants.
edits.after: You have the edge early because Aurelion Sol is a slow-scaling stacker with no burst or mobility, while your E (Hextech Ray) lets you shove and poke him off the wave. His whole game plan is farming Q (Breath of Light) stacks safely, so every minion and every bit of poke you deny sets his scaling back. Push the first waves in and force him to farm under tower or eat damage. Deny him the free early game he wants.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Gravity Field like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Astral Flight: 22s at rank 1, 16s max — his only escape; he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it like a summoner. - Your W Gravity Field (17s early) also stuns him out of his Q breath channel. - His R is 120s, yours 120/100/80 — trade evenly.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Siphon Power's shield (9s CD rank 1) soaks his Q breath ticks — cast it as the channel starts and his whole trade lands on a shield.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Chasing kills across the map trades your augment curve for coin flips — Astral Flight follows a roam faster than your legs will.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol wins by landing Astral Flight, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol wins by stacking untouched, dodging your laser with Astral Flight, and opening fights with his stun.
